result.summary: Found 1 major layout issue where text elements overlap on a restaurant card.

issues.description: Under the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' listing in the 'Popular right now' section, the delivery time ('25–35 min') and delivery fee ('€0 delivery') text elements are overlapping and illegible.
issues.suggestion: Fix the positioning or flex/inline layout of the metadata subtext items so that the delivery time and delivery fee are properly spaced and separated (e.g., '25–35 min • €0 delivery • Ramen').
